lines.text: the last one dropped without a sound. the rain didn't care. it just kept coming down.
the door gave in. the bass came through the frame, like a heartbeat in the dark that didn't know my name.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: "stay on the floor, sweeties. never mind the door."
the music played on, but the dancing had stopped. every sweet little face turned, and the whole room dropped.

lines.speaker: goon_b
lines.text: "we saved you a dance. you won't get a second chance."
